## What landed

`scripts/site/` — the seam this row owns (consumed by R6.5/R6.20/R6.21/R6.49;
the R6.5 generator calls these templates, one renderer — CC1):

- `assets/tokens.css` — every design/39 §Design tokens role in both
  first-class themes (light on `:root`/`[data-theme="light"]`, dark on
  `[data-theme="dark"]` plus a `prefers-color-scheme` fallback the JS-off
  path uses), the 8-slot series palette in F2's fixed order
  (cobalt, amber, verdigris, violet, rust, magenta, olive, sky), focus ring
  per tokens. Ratios equal design/39's recorded computation pair-for-pair.
- `assets/site.css` — type scale (display-1/2, h2, h3, body, reading,
  table, small, micro), 4 px-base space scale (4·8·12·16·24·32·48·64·96),
  1200 px content column, card spec (panel + 1 px rule + 6 px radius, no
  shadow), chip spec (28 px mono micro, ink-3 outline, needle under-edge
  active, struck-through disabled with reason), table spec (micro header,
  axis rule, hairline rows, right-aligned mono numbers), all six signature
  elements, receipt rail folding under 900 px, reduced-motion and print
  rules, 320 px single-column reflow.
- `assets/glyphs.svg` — sprite: the double-frame glyph (`#hh-glyph`) plus
  the eight disposition symbols (`g-verified` filled, `g-inconclusive`
  half, `g-withheld` dashed, `g-failed` struck, `g-infra` hatched,
  `g-unresolved` hollow, `g-absent` dotted circle, `g-flagged` pennant),
  all `currentColor` so shape + colour + text travel together.
- `assets/favicon.svg` — double frame + needle emitted verbatim, themed by
  media query (frames ink, needle needle-colour, both themes).
- `assets/site.js` — the `<button aria-pressed>` theme toggle only; all
  values are pre-rendered.
- `hhsite/` — stdlib package: `tokparse` (tokens.css parser; verifies
  `[data-theme="dark"]` == the media-query fallback), `contrast` (WCAG 2
  relative-luminance formula reimplemented per F2's condition),
  `raster` (PNG writer via `zlib`/`struct` — 8-bit RGBA, filter 0, fixed
  compression, no metadata chunks; the 32-unit double-frame geometry,
  rectangles only, byte-stable), `components` (stamps, interval rule +
  needle tick, noise-floor band, receipt rail, calibration block,
  numberless skeleton, absent block, and the component guards),
  `pages` (shell with header label slot, nav, calibration-block footer,
  hashed inline theme-init script under a CSP meta).
- `build_mock.py` — the one stdlib command; `--profile internal`
  (fixture mock) and `--profile all-absent` (the golden all-absent site);
  `--manifest` emits the golden record. Deterministic: no wall clock, no
  network, sorted writes.
- `config/harnesses.json` — `hh-site-harnesses/1`: two-character monograms
  + display names + `admission_order` (never rank; holds no measurement
  values).
- `fixtures/phase1.json` — `hh-site-fixture/1` labelled `fixture`: the
  design/39 F15 phase-1 values (tranche-3 30/30 + `verified` +
  "descriptive, no margin registered"; study `reported`/`unmet{s1_failed}`;
  spend `$0.00`/`unrecorded{pre_schema}`; the xcheck tile in its absent
  state awaiting `hh-surface-xcheck/1` at F2-b).
- `tests/test_tokens.py` — the committed WCAG ratio test (REQ-XF-102):
  40 token×surface pairs (9 text/status ≥ 4.5:1, 11 meaningful non-text
  ≥ 3:1, × panel + paper, × both themes); `--selftest` is the committed

- `tests/test_site.py` — the component-level battery (below).
- `golden/all-absent.manifest` — per-file sha256 + `tree` sha256 of the
  all-absent build (the committed golden all-absent site as a digest

- `golden/token-ratios.txt` — the committed palette/contrast validator

## Shell, URL map and mock pages

Every §9.2 path renders: `/`, `/phase-1/`, `/phase-1/tasks/`,
`/phase-2/`, `/phase-2/pilot/`, `/phase-2/quote/`, `/phase-2/fp/`,
`/phase-2/fp/frontier/`, `/phase-2/fp/noise/`, `/phase-2/fp/tasks/`,
`/phase-2/fp/trial/`, `/phase-3/`, `/phase-4/`, `/method/` (hub: six
absent sections incl. scan coverage states), `/spend/`, plus the
always-present `/limits/`, `/changelog/`, `/data/`, `/about/`, and the
internal-only `/specimen/`. Each data page renders its designed absent
state: typed reason (`not_yet_available`, `withheld{dataset_private}`,
`unrecorded{pre_schema}`), awaited schema (`hh-surface-xcheck/1`,
`comparative-quote/1`, `hh-comparative-results/1`, `hh-receipt-index/1`,
`hh-l1-conformance/1`, `hh-experiment-slot/1`, `hh-compute-cost/1`),
gate id (F2-b, FP-S, FP-E, FP-RESULTS, G-L1, GATE pub-FP + dataset
flip), and a numberless skeleton — bar class names carry no digits, so
mutation (r) is unambiguous. The home page renders channels + readings
tiles on the phase-1 fixtures; the specimen page shows every REQ-XF-101
element and all eight stamps pinned in light and dark side by side;
both carry the fixture label and are internal-profile only.

Theme: saved choice → `prefers-color-scheme`, applied before first paint
by an inline script whose sha256 is quoted in each page's CSP meta;
`#theme=light|dark` pins a theme for the review matrix; with JS off the
media query still applies. Rasterized assets: `favicon.png` (64×64,
transparent, rectangles only) and `og.png` (1200×630, glyph centred on
`--paper`, no numbers) — byte-identical across two builds.

- AC-1 (identity, D): golden HTML/CSS exists for the fixture pages;
  both themes; theme resolution saved → media-query → before-paint
  hashed inline script; JS-off media query present. Approval: GATE-G21's,
  not recorded here. MET-in-scope (gate pending).
- AC-2 (contrast): test_tokens.py computes all 40 pairs from tokens.css;
  passes; the committed mutation (m) fails it. MET.
- AC-3 (palette): ratio table committed (`golden/token-ratios.txt`); F2
  slot order pinned in tokens.css; `admission_order` in harnesses.json;
  scatter marks take monogram + direct label only — `series=` kwarg
  raises GuardError (tested). MET at component level; the scatter checker
  leg is R6.6's.
- AC-4 (token separation): `validate_chart_tokens` refuses status+series
  in one chart; mutation (t) caught at component level. MET; the (t)
  checker leg is R6.6's.
- AC-5 (dispositions): eight glyph+colour+verbatim-text stamps, legend,
  filterable; colour-only fragment fails `validate_stamp` (mutation (p));
  no collapse into "N/A" anywhere in the layer. MET at component level.
- AC-6 (fonts): static scan of the built output finds no font file,
  `@font-face`, `@import` or font request; system stacks only. MET at
  component level; the `no-third-party` leg is R6.6's.
- AC-7 (glyph + monograms): favicon.png + og.png byte-identical over two
  builds; monogram uniqueness/coverage test fails on collision or
  uncovered entry; no vendor logo in scripts/site/ (monograms are
  typographic). Originality vs HF/AA is presented at GATE-G21 — review,
  not self-certified. MET-in-scope.
- AC-8 (URL map + absent states): the golden all-absent build covers
  every §9.2 path including `/method/` with typed reason, awaited schema
  and gate id; a digit inserted in a skeleton fails `validate_skeleton`
  and the built-tree scan. MET.
- AC-9 (mock determinism): two runs → identical tree sha256; stdlib only;
  no network; `Cargo.toml`/`crates/` untouched (`git status` shows only
  `.gitignore` + `scripts/site/` + build-memory records). MET.
- AC-10 (universal): requirement ids stamped in the PR; run/PR/
  BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree at true completion; deviations rowed below.
  MET.
